title: IncidentChangeRequests
description: A list of incident ids with corresponding change requests.

ChangeRequest.description: A map where the keys are the names of the field to be modified by the corresponding new value provided. Values for changeable key names are :== [ WORKFLOW_STATUS ].

additionalProperties.description: The new value to modify the field identified by the key.

IncidentChangeRequest.description: An incident id with corresponding change requests.

incidentId.description: Unique identifier for a particular incident. The incident ID prefixes :== [ ANO - Sanctioned anomaly | APP - consolidated app violation | AUD - audit violation | CAP - cloud access policy violation | DLP - data loss policy violation | EPO - ePO violation | MAL - malware violation | SHW - Shadow anomaly | THR - threat ]

changeRequests.description: A map of change requests with the key being field name and the value being new value to set on said field.
